name: Fintech / Financial Services
org_structure_note: Strong compliance/risk functions embedded in product teams. Matrix reporting to regulators in some roles.
funding_stages: Seed → Series A → B → (regulatory heavy) → Growth → IPO
Heavy due diligence on compliance readiness.

regional_notes.na: SEC/FINRA/SEC-regulated. OCC for banking. New York/SF hubs. Faster regulatory sandbox.
regional_notes.emea: PSD2/PSD3 open banking. FCA (UK), BaFin (Germany), AMF (France). Strong consumer protection.
regional_notes.apac: Singapore MAS leader. Hong Kong, Australia. China tightly controlled. India UPI open network.
regional_notes.latam: Brazil leads (Pix, open finance). Mexico fintech law. Argentina crypto-friendly. Regulatory less mature.
